takeaways: The 44.6-point margin was larger than either team's main lineup leak, so the matchup was decided more by raw scoring than one obvious swap.
The clearest unit edge was total RB output: Nacua-Cola by 31.8 points.
Against projection, Nacua-Cola finished +54.1 while Pat Pidgeon finished -3.3.
The biggest started performance was Drake London for Nacua-Cola at 37.8 points.
